title: API key
description: This key's status, limits, usage and recent requests.
loadFailed: Could not load your API key
alert.off: This key is turned off. The proxy refuses its requests until the admin turns it on again.
alert.expired: This key expired on {date}. The proxy refuses its requests until the admin extends it.
alert.tokenLimit: This key reached its token limit, so the proxy turned it off. Its requests are refused until the admin raises the limit or resets usage, then turns the key on again.
alert.creditLimit: This key reached its credit limit, so the proxy turned it off. Its requests are refused until the admin raises the limit or resets usage, then turns the key on again.
alert.callLimit: This key reached its call limit. The proxy refuses its requests with a 429 error until the admin raises the limit or resets usage.
alert.notRequired: This server does not ask for API keys on its own address, so calls made there do not count here. Calls through its public link always do.
